---
description: Documentation standards for SDLC artifacts
applyTo: "docs/sdlc/**"
---
- Use clear, concise language; avoid jargon without explanation.
- Structure documents with headings, tables, and lists for readability.
- Include acceptance criteria for each requirement.
- Document all assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
- Provide evidence for all claims (test results, metrics, benchmarks).
- Link to related artifacts and external resources.
- Use diagrams where helpful (architecture, data flow, sequence).
- Mark items as PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED with clear status indicators.
- Include risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
- Version all artifacts with date stamps.
